answer_1.quote: Real-world Compositional & Interactive QA This category assesses interactive and compositional reasoning in realistic conversational settings. Benchmarks like LLaVA-Wilder , RealWorldQA (x.ai), and ImageDC  test a model's ability to handle open-ended questions, multi-turn dialogues, and complex visual-linguistic grounding, as well as its adaptation to diverse topics and coherence over extended interactions.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses in open-ended and interactive vision-language tasks, including dialogues and image descriptions.

answer_2.quote: We use lmms-eval  framework to perform evaluation.
